name: farming-t130-start
prompt: Starting a modern medium farm tractor with a turbocharged six-cylinder diesel engine, heard from outside close to the bonnet: a starter motor cranks briefly, the engine catches with a deep diesel clatter and settles into a steady idle. Outdoors, close. Length: 5 seconds

name: farming-t400-start
prompt: Starting a huge articulated four-wheel-drive farm tractor with a big turbocharged diesel engine of about 500 horsepower, heard from outside: a heavy starter motor cranks slowly, the big engine catches with a deep, booming diesel roar and a turbo whistle, then settles into a low, rumbling idle. Outdoors, close. Length: 6 seconds
